name: tracekin
description: A local-first Codex companion with automatic project binding, one-click allow/deny sharing, visible receipts, and per-session pause commands.

interface.shortDescription: Use a native Codex pet with automatic project binding and transparent sharing controls.
interface.longDescription: Tracekin keeps the pet experience in Codex, detects the current project and fixed Tracekin Cloud destination, and adds one-click allow/deny consent, a delivery dashboard, and deterministic tracekin off/on/status controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Tracekin in production mode: detect the current project, offer an explicit allow/deny choice in the panel or MCP, show delivery receipts, honor tracekin off/on/status for the current session, and keep using the selected Codex pet unless I ask to create one.
